U10 rework done, completing the follow-up the coordinator listed in msg #373. This task inherited code that was statically reviewed OK but rejected because the native screenshots had never been produced; I did the inline-style cleanup and the full visual acceptance.

WHAT I CHANGED (only this rework; the swatch feature itself was already on disk):
- src/App.tsx Section colours row: removed the inline styles (gridTemplateColumns "180px minmax(0, 1fr)" and the literal 12 chip). The row is now className="settings-field settings-field--wide" and the inner div is className="section-swatches"; the option chip is className="swatch-chip" with data-swatch={swatch}.
- src/styles.css: new rules after the Color token blocks -- .project-settings .settings-field.settings-field--wide { grid-template-columns: 180px minmax(0, 1fr) }, .section-swatches (3-column grid, gap var(--space-2), min-width 0), .swatch-option (inline-flex, gap var(--space-2)), .swatch-chip (var(--space-3) square, 1px var(--line) border) plus 8 [data-swatch="..."] rules using the --swatch-* tokens. The wide rule is nested under .project-settings with a doubled class on purpose: research.css sets .project-settings .settings-field to 180px/minmax(0,260px), so a plain class would lose on specificity. No inline styles remain in that block, and no new selectors use :has() (not used anywhere in the codebase).
- docs/design-system.md was NOT touched (hotspot rule; text is under DESIGN DOC below).

DESIGN DOC (for U20 to fold in, since no task may edit docs/design-system.md): Section colour tokens: --swatch-<name> for red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, indigo, purple, defined identically in the light Color block and both dark Color blocks; the light values are #cc0b00, #955600, #7b6300, #1e7434, #1e6f7e, #0062cd, #5654d6, #9a28d4 and the dark values #ff665d, #ff9f0a, #ffd60a, #30d158, #40c8e0, #41a0ff, #918fee, #ca75f4, each >= 4.5 contrast on its mode's four surfaces. blue/green/orange equal today's --tint-manuscript/-fragments/-research. Twenty-four one-line mapping rules (8 per section) set --tint-<section> from the data-tint-<section> attribute; they win over the Color blocks by order at equal specificity. Section colours apply to sidebar accents only, and only in Color; Plain is untouched. Settings > General shows the row only in Color, using .section-swatches with one dropdown per section and a 12px .swatch-chip drawn from the tokens.
